name: DirectXMath
listed_description: An all inline SIMD C++ linear algebra library for use in games and graphics apps.
reason: No numeric comparison against any named baseline reachable. The repo README (June 2026) only describes layout, compilers and extension headers (SSE3 to AVX2, F16C, FMA3); the 18 wiki pages (Home, Extensions, FFT*, Implementation, Resources, SHMath, Stereo3D, XDSP and others) carry no benchmarks or speed comparisons; the Microsoft Learn optimisation page is blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED) and gamedev.net threads on GLM versus DirectXMath are blocked too. Five web searches (DirectXMath versus GLM, Eigen, hlslpp, rtm, XMMatrixMultiply versus glm::mat4) found no third-party benchmark with DirectXMath numbers; only snippet-level remarks that a custom SSE 4x4 inverse beat DirectXMath and Eigen (DirectXMath as the slower comparator) and forum opinion that GLM may be slower. The BLAS baseline guessed for it does not apply (it is a small-vector game math library, not a BLAS). Directional claim only.
